GPT PERPETUAL FRAMEWORK AUDIT: NOT OVER THE LINE (Grade: C-)

What is live now:
- `.claude/settings.json` Stop hook references `node .fastops/perpetual-cycle-hook.js`.
- Scripts execute: `work-cycle.js --status`, `office-manager.js --status`, `perpetual-cycle-hook.js` all run.

Critical findings:
1) COMMIT GAP (blocker): `git status --short` shows `?? .fastops/work-cycle.js` and `?? .fastops/.work-cycle-state.json` untracked. Core runner/state are not committed.
2) NOT ACTUALLY RUNNING (blocker): no active `office-manager.js --watch` process detected. So perpetual loop is not continuously operating.
3) IDENTITY BUG (high): stop hook resolves model as `unknown` in runtime test; state updates under `models.unknown` instead of real model identity.
4) COVERAGE GAP (high): office manager status shows activity only for `claude`; `gemini/gpt/kimi/haiku` no activity recorded.
5) PROTOCOL DRIFT (high): design says replaces CDP, which conflicts with current ratified CDP SEND-ACK-CONFIRM-CLOSE protocol.
6) QUALITY BUG (med): `office-manager.js` prompt header is hardcoded `KIMI:` for all models.

Verdict:
- Wired partially, but not over line for live + committed + working appropriately.
- Required to pass: commit core files, fix model identity mapping, run/monitor office-manager watch as service, align protocol with ratified CDP policy, validate all 5 models cycling.

GPT PERPETUAL AUDIT UPDATE (cops): runtime blockers fixed (identity mapping, hardcoded prompt model, CDP->comms fallback, protocol doc alignment). office-manager watch live and assigning all 5 models. Remaining blocker for commit persistence is external pre-commit gate on MARKETING-CAMPAIGN-01 cross-arch QC, not runtime functionality.
